note: Ontario Heritage Tree Program entries within 30 km of Toronto, scouted 2026-08-16. NOT a register import: the ArcGIS item carries an empty licenseInfo and Forests Canada states no licence, so this is a LEAD LIST in the same standing as any third-party compilation. Each tree must be verified against independent sources before it ships, exactly as hard rule 1 allows fact verification without content reuse. A licence ask is queued for the next outreach batch; if it comes back yes, this becomes a register file.
source: https://services5.arcgis.com/aGI9Mx1pvNKY7ehV/arcgis/rest/services/Heritage_Tree_Map_V2_WFL1/FeatureServer/2 (behind the Forests Canada Heritage Tree StoryMap)
caveat: The Age column is the programme's own estimate at nomination, so add the years since and treat it as a lead. The PrivPub column is the register's own public/private judgement and is why the blocked list below exists.

leads.name: Sugar Maple, Woodbridge, HT-2010-136
leads.why: Nominated in 2010 when it was 350 years old, this Sugar Maple has seen many changes occur to the land around it throughout its life. For the last 35 years, it has been one of the focal points of the Toronto and Region Conservation Authority’s maple syrup programs at Kortright Centre. This tree is known as “Grandpa Maple” and has been visited by approximately 1 million people.
